title: Fixed Open Cant-hook Support Tool
description: One complete original fixed-open cant-hook with integral support foot. A long tapered timber lever enters a broad metal toe head, a separately thick curved hook turns around a visibly transverse fixed axle, and a sloping rigid support leg reaches a broad grounded foot. A real open jaw remains between the hook return and head toe. All parts form one connected static tool; no log payload, old scythe blade or detached rack. Static blunt game-art appearance only; no motion, rolling, gripping, lifting, load, operational, engineering or safety claim.
